subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should OpenClaw accept a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row as the WebChat/non-deliverable unresumable restart-recovery notice contract after this PR is rebased?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow fix, but it changes persisted session history and the branch is currently conflicting with current main's transcript helper, so automation should not decide the product/storage contract alone.

options.title: Rebase And Accept Transcript Fallback
options.body: Port the explicit transcript target into current main's helper and land if the focused tests still prove the WebChat notice path.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect proof before accepting the persisted transcript-notice contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or the SQLite route refactor to own the durable recovery contract first.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Accept Transcript Fallback
recommendation.body: Port the explicit transcript target into current main's helper and land if the focused tests still prove the WebChat notice path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest owner signal spans delivery-mirror transcript behavior, restart-recovery storage direction, and current adjacent SQLite route work.
